evidence.excerpt: Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness using the same base model, achieving 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively.
